question: Why does CareInflow only work with healthcare practices?
answer: Because doing one kind of work makes the work better. A studio that builds for a restaurant one month and a clinic the next never learns either properly. Working only with dental, dermatology, physiotherapy, eye, orthopaedic, paediatric, gynaecology, cosmetic and mental health practices means we learn the patterns once: how patients search, what worries them, what earns their trust. Every practice we take on gets the benefit of the last one.

question: How established is CareInflow?
answer: CareInflow started in 2026, and we would rather tell you that than let you work it out. What is not new is the standard behind it: the founder built websites in Gujarat, studied cybersecurity in Canada and spent more than a year at Microsoft before starting this. And every engagement is arranged so that a young studio is our risk to carry rather than yours. The price is fixed in writing before work begins. The domain, hosting, code and every account are in your name from day one, so if we ever part ways you lose nothing. Monthly plans run month to month with no lock-in. You talk to the person building your site, not an account manager. The work page shows what we have shipped, in full, and the free review shows you how we think before you have paid anything.

question: What does a clinic website cost?
answer: Our prices are published, so you do not have to ask. There are four website packages, and what separates them is how much of your local search we take responsibility for. A practice website is {{buildPractice}}. A practice website with your Google listing rebuilt and matched to it is {{buildGoogle}}, and that is the one most practices need. A site built around the treatments you want to compete for is {{buildSeo}}. A multi-specialty or multi-location practice starts at {{buildMulti}} and is quoted rather than packaged. After launch, Local SEO and Google Care is {{careGoogle}} a month. Those are starting points for a described scope. Your exact number is fixed in writing after the free review, and sometimes the honest answer is 'less than you expected'.

question: Why not use a cheap website builder or a freelancer?
answer: You can, and for some practices that is genuinely enough. What you are paying us for is a different thing from the building. A freelancer will build you pages; we plan the path a worried patient takes from a search to a message, write every page to answer what they actually came with, and match the site to how your practice already looks and sounds. That layer is what decides whether a website earns anything, and it is why our sites cost more than a template and less than an agency charges for the same work.

question: How long does the whole process take?
answer: A typical practice website takes four weeks: study, structure and words, design and build, then launch and measurement. Google Business Profile work runs alongside. We agree the timeline in writing before starting, and if something will take longer we say so at week one, not week four.

question: What happens after my website launches?
answer: Whatever you choose. Local SEO and Google Care is {{careGoogle}} a month: your Google listing managed, every review answered, local search and Search Console watched, one new treatment page written and published each month, and a written report. The two larger website packages include 90 days of support after launch before any of that starts. Without a plan you still own everything. Domain, hosting, code and accounts are in your name from day one, and that is written into every agreement.

question: Will my clinic rank number one on Google?
answer: We do not promise rankings, and we would be careful with anyone who does. Rankings depend on competition, reviews and time, none of which an agency controls. What we control, and commit to in writing, is the groundwork rankings are built on: real pages for real searches, a properly maintained Google Business Profile, valid structured data, and speed that passes Google's own measurements.

question: My clinic already has a website. Is that not enough?
answer: Maybe, and the free review will tell you honestly. Before that, check three things tonight on your own phone. How long your site takes to load on mobile data. Whether your Google listing shows the right hours and recent photographs. Whether searching a treatment you offer brings up your site at all. Most practices find at least one surprise.

question: Do you build apps, do branding, or run advertising?
answer: No. We are not an advertising agency, a branding studio or an app developer. We do websites, local SEO, Google Business Profile management, ongoing care and social media content, for healthcare practices. Those are what we are good at and we would rather stay good at them.

question: How do we start?
answer: Send your clinic's name on WhatsApp. Within two working days you get a free written review of what a patient currently sees: your listing, your site, your search results, and the three clinics ranking above you. If the answer is 'change nothing', we will say that. If there is work worth doing, we talk it through for about an hour, on WhatsApp or a call or a meeting you book, whichever suits you. You will have read the review by then, so it is a conversation about your practice rather than a pitch. Then the review becomes the plan we quote against.

question: Where is CareInflow based, and do you only work locally?
answer: We work from F-27, Platinum Plaza, Radhanpur Rd, Mehsana, Gujarat 384005. Our clients are across Gujarat: Mehsana, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Visnagar, Unjha, Patan, Kalol, Siddhpur, Palanpur and Rajkot, plus further afield where the work suits it. Photography is the one part that needs us in the room, so we come to you and arrange it as a proper visit. Everything else works just as well at a distance.

question: Who owns the website, you or my practice?
answer: Your practice, entirely. The domain, hosting, code, content, analytics and search accounts are all registered in your name from day one. If we ever part ways, you lose nothing and owe nothing further. We keep clients by being useful, not by holding their website hostage.

question: Can I keep my current domain name and email?
answer: Yes. We build the new website and point your existing domain at it, so patients who already know your address still find you. We also set up redirects, so the pages Google has indexed keep working instead of turning into errors. Your email keeps running throughout, and we plan the switch so nothing goes down during clinic hours.

question: Do you handle social media for clinics?
answer: Yes, and it is a service in its own right rather than an add-on. It starts at {{social}} a month: a monthly content strategy and calendar, Instagram profile optimisation, up to four content pieces a week, captions and publishing, three reel edits from footage you provide, and a monthly review of what worked. The mix of formats follows the strategy rather than a fixed quota, so we are accountable for the volume and the thinking, not for manufacturing sixteen identical graphics. All of it stays inside the limits patient privacy sets. Shoots, complex carousels and advertising are quoted separately, and we do not chase follower counts.

question: Do I have to pay everything upfront?
answer: No. A standard build is paid in two halves, one to begin and one at launch. Larger builds split into three: at the start, at design approval, and at launch. Monthly plans are billed monthly in advance and you can stop by sending a message. There is no deposit that we keep if you change your mind before work begins.

question: Are the published prices inclusive of GST?
answer: The prices on the pricing page are in Indian rupees and exclude GST where it applies. Your written scope shows the figure, the tax and the total separately, so there is nothing to work out afterwards. Domain and hosting are not marked up by us at all. You pay those directly, in your own name.

question: What is the difference between the four website packages?
answer: How much we do for you, not how many pages you get. At {{buildPractice}} we build the website and set it up so Google can find it, and we check your Google listing before we start. At {{buildGoogle}} we also fix the listing itself: the right categories, the right services, correct hours and photos, and a listing that says the same thing as your site. At {{buildSeo}} we work out which treatments patients are searching for near you, and build the site to answer those. Above {{buildMulti}} we plan and build the whole thing for a practice with several doctors, departments or branches, and that one is quoted rather than sold as a package. The free review tells you which one you need, and it is usually a smaller one than people expect.

question: What if I only want my Google listing fixed?
answer: Then that is all we will sell you. A one-time Google Business Profile rebuild is {{gbpRebuild}}: claimed or verified, categories and services rebuilt, hours, photos, questions seeded and a review flow set up, with no monthly commitment attached. If you want it kept that way afterwards, Local SEO and Google Care is {{careGoogle}} a month and covers the listing along with the rest. If you do not, nothing changes and you owe nothing further.

question: Will the price go up later?
answer: The studio's rates will move as the work behind them does, but the price agreed at the start of your engagement is held for as long as we work together, even after our rates change. There is no deadline attached to a quote, and nothing comes off the number for deciding this week instead of next.

question: Why is the website cheaper than the quotes I have had elsewhere?
answer: Because we do not build the expensive kind. Our sites are hand-built and static. There is no application running behind them, nothing to break, and almost nothing to host. Agencies price a clinic website like a software project, and it is not one. What we do charge properly for is the part that decides whether the site earns anything: the path a patient takes from landing to messaging you, and the words on every page.

question: Do you look at my Google listing before building the website?
answer: Always, and it is included in every package including the smallest. We go through the profile line by line first: is it verified, is the name and address and phone right, is the primary category correct, does it link to the right website, are the hours and services right, are there photographs, what do the reviews say and does anyone reply, are there duplicate listings, and who is competing with you. You cannot sensibly build a site for a practice whose listing is unverified or pointing somewhere else, and finding that out after launch is finding it out too late.

question: If I buy a website, will patients find me on Google?
answer: A website is only one part of local search. Your Google Business Profile, your reviews, your competition, your location and your website all influence whether patients find you. That is why every package includes a local-search foundation and an audit of your listing. We do not guarantee rankings, and nobody honestly can. What we do is make sure the website and the Google presence are properly structured, so your practice has the strongest foundation we can actually control. If you want that foundation maintained and improved after launch, that is what the monthly plan is for.
